# agentic-spreadsheet

Spreadsheets with formulas that people and agents edit together.

Keywords: spreadsheet,sheets,formulas,grid,collaboration,agents,mcp,cli,csv,xlsx.

- SDK: import { Workbook } from "agentic-spreadsheet".
- Other SDK exports: parseCell, formatCell, parseRange, colIndex, colLetters (A1); parseCsv, formatCsv, inferCell (CSV);
  createMemoryStore, createMemoryBlobs, createFileStore, createFileBlobs (stores); StoreConflictError; ctxFromEnv; OPS;
  OpError (HTTP status 404, 409, 413); SheetError; toBase64, fromBase64; MAX_COL, MAX_ROW, MAX_TEXT, MAX_SHEET_NAME, MAX_STRUCTURE_COUNT; isMachineMade; PRINCIPAL_KINDS; VERSION.
  See README, "Other exports" and "Limits".
- ODS and XLSX: import { exportFile, importFile } from "agentic-spreadsheet/formats". exportFile(format, book) and
  importFile(format, bytes, book, principal) map a Workbook to and from the file, through agentic-formats.
- Remote SDK: import { createClient } from "agentic-spreadsheet/client". Calls the Worker API with fetch only.
  One method per route: list, create, read, write, setFormula, insertRows, deleteRows, insertCols,
  deleteCols, sheets, addSheet, deleteSheet, exportCsv, importCsv, share, shares, unshare, invite, invites, uninvite, link, links, unlink, remove, health.
  A failed call throws SheetsApiError with status and code (bad_request, unauthorized, forbidden,
  not_found, conflict, too_large, server_error, or unknown for another status). No retries. Pass
  { signal } to cancel.
- CLI and MCP sharing: share, shares, unshare, invite, invites, uninvite, link, links, and unlink (MCP: the same names with a sheet_ prefix) call a Worker. Set SHEET_URL and SHEET_TOKEN. A share takes --subject and --subject-kind (human or agent) and --role. An invite or a link takes --role (never owner); an invite takes --email or --handle. A link token shows once.
- Mountable UI: import { mount } from "agentic-spreadsheet/ui" and import "agentic-spreadsheet/ui.css".
  mount(element, { client, docId, principal: { kind, name }, readOnly?, token?, onUnauthorized? }) renders the
  sheet into the element and returns { update(options), unmount() }. A principal without a known kind throws
  TypeError. Also exports WorkbookView (React component, needs agentic-design providers). React and react-dom
  are peer dependencies. The client comes from agentic-spreadsheet/client.
  With host: mount(element, { docId, principal: { kind, name, id }, host: { doc, presence?, status?, onStatus? } }) shows a
  Y.Doc that your app keeps in its own room; the sheet then calls no client, does not poll, and opens no room.
- Web UI: from a checkout of this repo, run npm ci and npm run build. Put SHEETS_API_KEYS, SHEETS_REGION=unknown, and SHEETS_UNSAFE_REGION=1 in .dev.vars (see
  README, "UI"). Then run npx wrangler dev, and open the printed address. Sign in with an API key. The npm
  package ships the UI files in dist/ui, but not wrangler.jsonc, so the Worker runs from the repo. It uses the
  typed client, agentic-design, and a presence room from agentic-realtime. See README, "UI".
  To host the UI from the npm package: read dist/ui from node_modules/agentic-spreadsheet/dist/ui, serve it at the
  root of an origin, and answer every path under /api/v1/sheets/, and /health, with the default export of agentic-spreadsheet/worker.
  Pass an env with SHEETS_REGION, and the DB (D1) and BLOBS (R2) bindings, or the Worker answers 500.
  Presence works only from a checkout (src/ui-worker.ts). Without it, the UI still works and shows Offline.
- CLI and MCP: run agentic-spreadsheet --help, or agentic-spreadsheet mcp.

## Package export reference

The examples above show the main calls. The lists below include the TypeScript types. Import types with `import type`.

### `agentic-spreadsheet`

`Workbook` holds sheets; `Engine` computes values. `parseCell`, `formatCell`, `parseRange`, `colIndex`, and `colLetters` handle A1 addresses. `parseCsv`, `formatCsv`, and `inferCell` handle CSV. `toBase64` and `fromBase64` convert bytes. `isMachineMade` checks a principal kind; `PRINCIPAL_KINDS` lists the kinds. `VERSION`, `MAX_COL`, `MAX_ROW`, `MAX_TEXT`, `MAX_SHEET_NAME`, and `MAX_STRUCTURE_COUNT` are constants. `SheetError` reports invalid workbook input.

`createMemoryStore` and `createMemoryBlobs` make in-memory adapters. `createFileStore` and `createFileBlobs` make file adapters. `StoreConflictError` reports a failed transaction. `ctxFromEnv` makes a CLI context; `OPS` and `OpError` expose operations and their errors.

Types: `Author`, `Blobs`, `Cell`, `CellFormat`, `CellFormatPatch`, `CellInput`, `CellPos`, `CellValue`, `Change`, `Ctx`, `ErrorCode`, `ErrorValue`, `FileStoreOptions`, `Op`, `Principal`, `PrincipalKind`, `RangePos`, `SheetInfo`, `Store`, `StoreOps`, and `Value`.

```ts
import { createMemoryStore, parseCell } from "agentic-spreadsheet";
const store = createMemoryStore();
const position = parseCell("B2");
```

### `agentic-spreadsheet/client`

`createClient` makes the HTTP client and `SheetsApiError` reports HTTP failures. Types: `CallOptions`, `Cell`, `CellAuthor`, `ClientOptions`, `ErrorCode`, `FormulaError`, `InviteSummary`, `LinkSummary`, `PrincipalKind`, `ReadResult`, `ShareRole`, `SheetTarget`, `SheetsClient`, `SubjectKind`, and `Value`. Example: `createClient({ baseUrl: "https://sheets.example.com", token: "key" })`.

### `agentic-spreadsheet/formats`

`exportFile`, `importFile`, `formatOf`, `MIME`, `toFileBook`, and `addSheets` handle ODS and XLSX. `MAX_IMPORT_SHEETS` is the sheet limit. `SheetFormat` is the format type. Example: `formatOf("book.xlsx")` returns `"xlsx"`.

### `agentic-spreadsheet/ui`

`mount` mounts a sheet and `WorkbookView` is its React component. Types: `EmbedPrincipal`, `HostWorkbook`, `MountOptions`, `MountedSheet`, `PrincipalKind`, `RoomPresence`, `SheetCalls`, and `SheetsClient`. Example: `mount(element, { client, docId: "budget", principal: { kind: "agent", name: "bot" } })`.

### `agentic-spreadsheet/ui.css`

Load the styles with the UI:

```ts
import "agentic-spreadsheet/ui.css";
```

### `agentic-spreadsheet/worker`

The `default` export is the Worker handler. `createApp` builds the HTTP app with supplied ports; `fromAuth` adapts an identity Auth port. `storageFor` builds ports from Worker bindings. `roomGrant` checks a presence request, `roomRole` caps its role, and `WS_PROTOCOL` names its WebSocket protocol. `AppOptions` and `WorkerEnv` are types.

```ts
import worker, { roomRole } from "agentic-spreadsheet/worker";
const role = roomRole("editor", []);
export default worker;
```

### `agentic-spreadsheet/account`

`spreadsheetAccount` implements account export and erase; `SpreadsheetAccountError` reports damaged account data. `SpreadsheetAccount`, `SpreadsheetAccountDeps`, and `SpreadsheetCollection` are types. Example: `spreadsheetAccount.exportAccount(subject, { store, blobs })`.

The CLI and MCP server are commands, not import subpaths. For example, run `npx agentic-spreadsheet --help` or `npx agentic-spreadsheet mcp`. The storage adapters above are root exports, not an adapters subpath.
